# This file is generated by AI.

# 视频渲染器子项目。
#
# 只产出一个静态库 `webgal-video-render`: 由 Rust crate `webgal-video-render-sys`
# 通过 C ABI (include/webgal-video-render.h) 链接进 Ink, 不再提供命令行可执行文件。
# 构建入口在仓库根 CMakeLists.txt, 依赖清单在根 vcpkg.json。

find_package(Vulkan REQUIRED)
# Live2D 的 model3.json / motion3.json / exp3.json 仍需要 JSON 解析;
# 这里只为读取资源清单, 与 Rust 侧的通信已改走 C ABI。
find_package(nlohmann_json CONFIG REQUIRED)

# 只有本渲染器会把运行时换成 /MT (Rust 侧 +crt-static 时必须一致), 因此选项声明在这里。
option(WEBGAL_RENDER_STATIC_CRT "Link the MSVC runtime statically (/MT)" OFF)

find_path(WEBGAL_STB_INCLUDE_DIR NAMES stb_truetype.h REQUIRED)
find_path(WEBGAL_DRLIBS_INCLUDE_DIR NAMES dr_wav.h REQUIRED)

add_library(webgal_third_party INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(webgal_third_party SYSTEM INTERFACE
    "${WEBGAL_STB_INCLUDE_DIR}"
    "${WEBGAL_DRLIBS_INCLUDE_DIR}"
)
target_link_libraries(webgal_third_party INTERFACE nlohmann_json::nlohmann_json)

find_program(WEBGAL_GLSLC NAMES glslc HINTS "${VULKAN_SDK}/Bin" "$ENV{VULKAN_SDK}/Bin")
if(NOT WEBGAL_GLSLC)
    message(FATAL_ERROR "找不到 glslc, 请安装 Vulkan SDK 并确保 Bin 在 PATH")
endif()

# ---- shader: glslc -> .spv -> 构建期生成的 C++ 字节数组 ----

set(WEBGAL_SHADER_NAMES quad.vert quad.frag)
set(WEBGAL_SHADER_OUTPUT_DIR "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/shaders")
set(WEBGAL_SHADER_OUTPUTS)
foreach(shader IN LISTS WEBGAL_SHADER_NAMES)
    get_filename_component(shader_ext "${shader}" EXT)
    string(SUBSTRING "${shader_ext}" 1 -1 shader_stage)
    set(output "${WEBGAL_SHADER_OUTPUT_DIR}/${shader}.spv")
    add_custom_command(
        OUTPUT "${output}"
        COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}" -E make_directory "${WEBGAL_SHADER_OUTPUT_DIR}"
        COMMAND "${WEBGAL_GLSLC}" "-fshader-stage=${shader_stage}"
                "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/shaders/${shader}" -o "${output}"
        DEPENDS "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/shaders/${shader}"
        COMMENT "Compiling ${shader}"
    )
    list(APPEND WEBGAL_SHADER_OUTPUTS "${output}")
endforeach()

set(WEBGAL_EMBEDDED_SHADERS
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated/shaders/embedded_shaders.cpp")
add_custom_command(
    OUTPUT "${WEBGAL_EMBEDDED_SHADERS}"
    COMMAND "${CMAKE_COMMAND}"
            "-DSPV_DIR=${WEBGAL_SHADER_OUTPUT_DIR}"
            "-DOUTPUT_CPP=${WEBGAL_EMBEDDED_SHADERS}"
            -P "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/embed-shaders.cmake"
    DEPENDS ${WEBGAL_SHADER_OUTPUTS} "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cmake/embed-shaders.cmake"
    COMMENT "Embedding shaders"
    VERBATIM
)

# ---- 静态库 ----

set(WEBGAL_RENDER_INTERNAL_INCLUDES
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src"
    "${CMAKE_CURRENT_BINARY_DIR}/generated")

add_library(webgal-video-render STATIC
    src/bridge/api.cpp
    src/common/log.cpp
    src/live2d/core_loader.cpp
    src/live2d/model.cpp
    src/media/audio.cpp
    src/media/image.cpp
    src/media/mf_encoder.cpp
    src/media/preview.cpp
    src/media/stb_vorbis_impl.cpp
    src/pipeline/export.cpp
    src/stage/renderer.cpp
    "${WEBGAL_EMBEDDED_SHADERS}"
)

target_include_directories(webgal-video-render
    PUBLIC
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include"
    PRIVATE
        ${WEBGAL_RENDER_INTERNAL_INCLUDES}
)

target_link_libraries(webgal-video-render
    PUBLIC
        webgal_warnings
    PRIVATE
        webgal_third_party
        Vulkan::Vulkan
        windowscodecs
        ole32
        mfplat
        mfreadwrite
        mfuuid
)

if(WEBGAL_RENDER_STATIC_CRT)
    set_property(TARGET webgal-video-render PROPERTY
        MSVC_RUNTIME_LIBRARY "MultiThreaded$<$<CONFIG:Debug>:Debug>")
endif()

if(MSVC)
    # 源文件是 UTF-8 且包含中文注释; 不指定编码时 MSVC 会按系统代码页解释.
    target_compile_options(webgal-video-render PRIVATE /utf-8)
    # stb_vorbis 的 C 实现按 C++ 编译, 只关闭它触发的未初始化告警.
    set_source_files_properties(
        "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/src/media/stb_vorbis_impl.cpp"
        PROPERTIES COMPILE_OPTIONS "/wd4701"
    )
endif()

install(TARGETS webgal-video-render ARCHIVE DESTINATION lib)
install(FILES "${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/include/webgal-video-render.h"
        DESTINATION include)

add_subdirectory(tests)
